npm.reason: No patched release exists (affects <=3.0.3, the latest). Build-time only, via tailwindcss 3, chokidar and micromatch. Disputed, see https://github.com/micromatch/braces/issues/73.
No patched release exists (affects <=1.4.0, the latest). Build-time only, via @expo/cli (iOS signing identity lookup); not in the app bundle and expo-updates code signing is not used.

Fixed only in 0.5.0, which is ESM-only and breaks the require() in query-string 7 used by expo-router (still on query-string 7 in SDK 57). Impact is a client-side CPU DoS from a crafted deep link query string; recheck on the next Expo SDK upgrade.

cargo.reason: The Marvin timing attack is primarily relevant when an attacker can observe decryption timing, such as over a network. Since decryption is performed client-side only and uses decrypt_blinded, this provides a sufficient mitigation.
